== Description ==

At a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Jacy Smith]] (left) and [[Mike Turner]] (right, tan cap) playing, with [[Nathan Davis]] (center, blue Mariners shirt and cap) and [[Brandon Baity]] (standing right, olive jacket) watching.
